newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list three equity options on January 21.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list three equity options on January 21.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Thursday it would list options on Arbor Drugs Inc, Pharmaceutical Product Development Inc and Sheldahl Inc on January 21.
The exchange said position limits for all three new options would be 4,500 contracts.
It said Arbor Drugs and Pharmaceutical Product Development options would open with expirations in February, March, April and July.
Opening strike prices for Arbor Drugs would be 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2. The stock closed at 19-3/8 Thursday.
Mercury Trading has been named the specialist.
Pharmaceutical Product Development options will open with strikes of 22-1/2, 25 and 30.
Gateway Partners has been named the specialist.
For Sheldahl, the options would open with strikes of 20, 22-1/2 and 25, with initial expirations in February, March, June and September. The stock ended Thursday at 23-1/8.
Susquehanna Investment Group has been named the specialist.
